data.name: Blocking
data.value: {0} blocks the shared connection until data arrives. Use the non-blocking form, such as LPOP or XREAD without BLOCK.
data.comment: {0} is a Redis command such as BLPOP.

data.name: Bytes_One
data.value: {0} byte
data.comment: {0} is a number of bytes.

data.name: Bytes_Other
data.value: {0} bytes
data.comment: {0} is a number of bytes.

data.name: CannotStoreNull
data.value: Redis cannot store NULL. Enter an empty value instead.

data.name: CannotStoreNullValue
data.value: Redis cannot store NULL as a value. Enter an empty value instead.

data.name: ClientReply
data.value: CLIENT REPLY would stop the replies every tab waits for.

data.name: ClusterDatabaseOption
data.value: Redis Cluster serves database 0 only. Clear the database number, or use standalone mode.

data.name: ClusterDatabaseZero
data.value: Redis Cluster serves database 0 only.

data.name: CommandNotFinished
data.value: The command did not finish within {0} seconds.
data.comment: {0} is a number of seconds.

data.name: ConnectionState
data.value: {0} changes the shared connection's login or state. Change the connection's settings instead.
data.comment: {0} is a Redis command such as AUTH.

data.name: CrossSlot
data.value: The queued commands touch keys in more than one hash slot, which a cluster cannot run in one transaction. Give the keys a shared {hash tag} so they land in one slot.
data.comment: Follows the CROSSSLOT error code. Read with Get, so {hash tag} is literal.

data.name: CurrentValue
data.value: (current value)
data.comment: Stands in for a value in a preview of the commands a save will send.

data.name: CursorRestarted
data.value: The cursor named a node the cluster no longer has, so the scan started again from the first primary.

data.name: DatabaseSelected_One
data.value: Database {1} selected, {0} key.
data.comment: {0} key count, {1} database number.

data.name: DatabaseSelected_Other
data.value: Database {1} selected, {0} keys.
data.comment: {0} key count, {1} database number.

data.name: DbBrowseWith
data.value: # Browse with: {0}
data.comment: A comment line. {0} is a command.

data.name: DbHeader
data.value: # Redis database: {0}
data.comment: A comment line in a database's description. {0} is a database name such as db0.

data.name: DbKeys
data.value: # Keys: {0}
data.comment: A comment line. {0} is a key count or the word unknown.

data.name: DbTypes_One
data.value: # Type distribution (sampled {0} key):
data.comment: A comment line. {0} is how many keys were sampled.

data.name: DbTypes_Other
data.value: # Type distribution (sampled {0} keys):
data.comment: A comment line. {0} is how many keys were sampled.

data.name: EmptyCommand
data.value: Empty command.

data.name: FieldsComment
data.value: A JSON object of field names to values

data.name: HashFieldGone
data.value: The hash field '{0}' no longer exists, so nothing was saved.
data.comment: {0} is a hash field name.

data.name: HashRowNeedsField
data.value: A new hash row needs a field name.

data.name: IndexComment
data.value: Position from the head, starting at 0

data.name: IsSentinel
data.value: This is a Redis Sentinel, not a data node, so it only answers SENTINEL commands. Set the connection mode to sentinel and list this address among the Sentinel nodes.
data.comment: SENTINEL is a command name and stays English.

data.name: JsonNeedsPath
data.value: A new JSON member needs a path, such as $.name.

data.name: JsonPathFixed
data.value: A JSON member's path cannot be edited. Delete it and add the value under the new path.

data.name: JsonTextComment
data.value: JSON text

data.name: KeyGone
data.value: The key '{0}' no longer exists.
data.comment: {0} is a key name.

data.name: KeyNameComment
data.value: The key's name

data.name: KeyNameNotText
data.value: This key's name is not text, so it cannot be addressed from the grid.

data.name: KeyTypeNotEditable
data.value: The key '{0}' holds a type the grid cannot edit. Change it with a command in the query editor.
data.comment: {0} is a key name.

data.name: KeyTypeNotShown
data.value: The key '{0}' holds a type the grid cannot show. Read it with a command in the query editor.
data.comment: {0} is a key name.

data.name: LengthComment
data.value: Bytes of a string, or elements of a collection

data.name: ListOneNode
data.value: List at least one node to connect to, as host:port.

data.name: ListPositionFixed
data.value: A list element's position cannot be edited. Delete it and add the value again.

data.name: NewKeyNeedsName
data.value: A new key needs a name.

data.name: NextCursor
data.value: Next cursor: {0}
data.comment: {0} is the cursor value.

data.name: NoListPosition
data.value: The row has no list position, so it cannot be addressed.

data.name: NoServer
data.value: No Redis server is connected.

data.name: NotACluster
data.value: This server is not running in cluster mode. Set the connection mode to standalone, or point cluster mode at a node started with cluster-enabled yes.
data.comment: cluster-enabled yes is a server setting and stays English.

data.name: NotAScore
data.value: '{0}' is not a score. A score is a number, inf or -inf.
data.comment: {0} is what the user typed. inf and -inf stay English.

data.name: NotClientId
data.value: '{0}' is not a Redis client id.
data.comment: {0} is what was given.

data.name: NotDatabaseNumber
data.value: '{0}' is not a Redis database number. Use a number such as 0 or a name such as db0.
data.comment: {0} is what the user entered. db0 stays as is.

data.name: NotHost
data.value: '{0}' is not a host or host:port.
data.comment: {0} is what was entered.

data.name: NotMode
data.value: '{0}' is not a Redis connection mode. Use standalone, sentinel or cluster.
data.comment: {0} is what was entered. standalone, sentinel and cluster stay English.

data.name: NotRun
data.value: not run
data.comment: Shown in place of a reply for a queued command that never ran.

data.name: NoWhereElements
data.value: Redis has no WHERE clause. Use the filter rules, or SCAN with MATCH in the query editor.

data.name: NoWhereKeys
data.value: Redis has no WHERE clause. Filter on the Key column with a pattern such as user:*, or on Type.
data.comment: Key and Type are column names; user:* is a pattern.

data.name: OnlyKeyTypeCounted
data.value: Only the key and type filters are counted on the server.

data.name: PartialSlots
data.value: {0} of {1} hash slots ran their part before another refused; those changes stay applied.
data.comment: {0} slots that ran, {1} slots in all.

data.name: PartOfCluster
data.value: This server is part of a Redis Cluster, so requests for keys it does not own would fail. Set the connection mode to cluster and list this address among the cluster nodes.

data.name: PathComment
data.value: JSONPath of the member

data.name: ReadOnlyNoDisconnect
data.value: This connection is read-only, so the client was not disconnected.

data.name: ReadOnlyNotSent
data.value: This connection is read-only, so {0} was not sent.
data.comment: {0} is a Redis command.

data.name: RenameEmpty
data.value: A key can only be renamed to text that is not empty.

data.name: RowHasNo
data.value: The row has no {0}, so it cannot be addressed.
data.comment: {0} is one of the What* phrases, such as hash field.

data.name: SaveSomeFailed
data.value: Redis ran the save, but some commands failed and the rest stayed applied: {0}
data.comment: {0} lists each failed command with the server's reply.

data.name: ScanComplete
data.value: Cursor 0: the scan is complete.

data.name: Seconds_One
data.value: {0} second
data.comment: {0} is a number of seconds.

data.name: Seconds_Other
data.value: {0} seconds
data.comment: {0} is a number of seconds.

data.name: SelectInMulti
data.value: SELECT cannot be queued inside MULTI here. Select the database before MULTI.

data.name: SelectOneNumber
data.value: SELECT takes one database number, such as SELECT 1
data.comment: Follows the ERR error code. SELECT stays English.

data.name: SentinelThroughTunnel
data.value: A tunnel forwards one address, and the node Sentinel names is on the server's own network, so Sentinel mode cannot run through one. Connect to a data node directly, or turn the tunnel off.

data.name: SentinelToSentinel
data.value: Sentinel resolved to another Sentinel rather than a data node. Check the primary group name in your Sentinel configuration.

data.name: SlotsPartiallySaved
data.value: {0} of {1} hash slots were saved and stay applied; the next failed: {2}
data.comment: {0} slots saved, {1} slots in all, {2} the error.

data.name: SortedSetMemberGone
data.value: The sorted set member '{0}' no longer exists, so nothing was saved.
data.comment: {0} is a member.

data.name: StreamEntriesFixed
data.value: Stream entries cannot change once added. Delete the entry and add a new one.

data.name: StreamFieldsNotObject
data.value: A stream entry's fields must be a JSON object: {0}
data.comment: {0} is the JSON parser's message.

data.name: StreamFieldsObject
data.value: Stream fields must be a JSON object such as {"field": "value"}.
data.comment: Read with Get, so the JSON braces are literal.

data.name: StreamIdComment
data.value: Leave empty when adding to let the server assign one

data.name: StreamNeedsFields
data.value: A new stream entry needs its fields as a JSON object, such as {"name": "value"}.
data.comment: Read with Get, so the JSON braces are literal.

data.name: StreamNeedsOneField
data.value: A stream entry needs at least one field.

data.name: StringHoldsOneValue
data.value: A string key holds one value. Edit that value instead of adding a row.

data.name: Subscription
data.value: {0} turns the connection into a message stream, which the editor cannot show. Use redis-cli for it.
data.comment: {0} is a Redis command such as SUBSCRIBE.

data.name: TtlComment
data.value: Seconds until the key expires; -1 or NULL for none

data.name: TtlInvalid
data.value: TTL has to be a whole number of seconds above 0, or -1 or NULL for no expiry.

data.name: TtlNoExpiry
data.value: -1 (no expiry)

data.name: TtlNoKey
data.value: -2 (the key does not exist)

data.name: TypeComment
data.value: string, hash, list, set or zset when adding a key
data.comment: The type names stay English.

data.name: TypeNotAddable
data.value: A {0} key cannot be added from the grid. Add it with a command in the query editor.
data.comment: {0} is a Redis type name such as stream.

data.name: Unknown
data.value: unknown

data.name: ValueComment
data.value: A string's value, or a preview of a collection's first elements

data.name: ValueInListNotEditable
data.value: The value of a {0} key cannot be edited in the list of keys. Open the key to edit its elements.
data.comment: {0} is a Redis type name such as hash.

data.name: WhatHashField
data.value: hash field
data.comment: Fills RowHasNo.

data.name: WhatJsonPath
data.value: JSON path
data.comment: Fills RowHasNo.

data.name: WhatSetMember
data.value: set member
data.comment: Fills RowHasNo.

data.name: WhatSortedSetMember
data.value: sorted set member
data.comment: Fills RowHasNo.

data.name: WhatStreamId
data.value: stream entry id
data.comment: Fills RowHasNo.
